restaurantName: The Tasting Room by Marcello Corrado
bio: In Merano, within the elegant setting of Villa Eden, an intimate dining room with gilded accents and just four tables sets the stage for an exclusive candlelit experience. Chef Marcello Corrado presents two tasting menus: “EDEN-Holistic,” dedicated to wellness, and “LOCAL HOMAGE,” a tribute to the region’s finest products. Light yet satisfying flavors come together in creatively crafted dishes, complemented by attentive, professional service that rounds out a refined gastronomic experience....
pageTitle: The Tasting Room by Marcello Corrado
